title: The Owl and the Cow
note: b381 — first use of 'farmhouse', 'cow', 'coin', 'chair'; first use of the 'listen' pose.

pages.brief: Olive the plum-coloured spotted owl on a branch high in the oak, round and dignified, big amber eyes straight at the reader. Introduce her properly — she has presence.
pages.alt: Olive the plum-coloured owl sits up on a branch high in the oak, round and dignified, her big amber eyes looking straight at the reader.

pages.brief: Wide dusk scene of the whole farmyard going blue and cool, lit windows in the farmhouse, the oak dark against the sky.
pages.alt: A wide dusk view of the whole farmyard going blue and cool, with lit windows in the farmhouse and the oak standing dark against the sky.

pages.brief: A large gentle cow standing in the yard beside the barn, seen from low down so she looks enormous. Warm brown against cool blue night.
pages.alt: A large gentle cow stands in the yard beside the barn, seen from low down so she looks enormous against the cool blue night.

pages.brief: Ned with his head tilted right over, one flipper cupped by his ear, listening intently. The cow drawn small in the distance behind him.
pages.alt: Ned stands with his head tilted right over, one flipper cupped by his ear, listening intently, with the cow drawn small in the distance behind him.

pages.brief: Close portrait of the cow's face with a fine pair of curved horns, breath steaming in the cold air. Detailed, calm, characterful.
pages.alt: A close portrait of the cow's calm, characterful face with a fine pair of curved horns, her breath steaming in the cold air.

pages.brief: Pip peering down at a small round coin half buried in dark soil, one bright edge catching the moonlight. Close, low, treasure-hunt feeling.
pages.alt: Pip peers down at a small round coin half buried in dark soil, one bright edge catching the moonlight.

pages.brief: The three of them at a farm gate at night, looking back the way they came, then facing forward together. Determined little silhouettes.
pages.alt: Pip, Ned and Olive stand together at a farm gate at night, determined little silhouettes facing forward together.

pages.brief: Ned sitting on an old wooden kitchen chair someone has left in the yard, feet not reaching the ground, entirely at home. Absurd and delightful.
pages.alt: Ned sits on an old wooden kitchen chair left out in the yard, his feet not reaching the ground, entirely at home.

pages.brief: Wide winter night: frost on the yard, bare branches, breath clouds, the barn light the only warm thing in the picture.
pages.alt: A wide winter night over the farmyard: frost on the ground, bare branches, and the barn's single lit window the only warm thing in the picture.

pages.brief: Closing page: Pip and Olive on the branch together looking down at the cow far below, the whole farmyard laid out beneath them. Peaceful aerial view — a wide establishing shot by design, everyone reads small and far from this height.
pages.alt: Pip and Olive sit together on their branch, looking peacefully down at the cow far below with the whole farmyard laid out beneath them.
